# About this guide {.unnumbered}

Written for teachers at Utrecht University who want to turn a course reader
into a website.

It merges three sources:

- a scaffold outline of what colleagues need to be taught, in order;
- the tricks used in the **Biologische Modellen en Statistiek** book — iframes,
  shared LaTeX macros, `freeze` versus `cache`, SCSS theming;
- a practical walkthrough of setup, figures, interactive applets and publishing.

The theme follows the
[Utrecht University corporate identity](https://www.uu.nl/en/organisation/corporate-identity):
Merriweather and Open Sans as the standard fonts, UU red for links, UU yellow
as the accent, and the supporting palette for callouts. `uu.scss` in this
project is free to copy into your own book.

The book is deliberately single-theme: the UU palette is defined against white
paper, so there is no dark mode and no toggle. See @sec-theming if you want one
anyway.

## Source material

- `Onderwijs/BMS/Boek` — the Dutch course book
- `Onderwijs/Modeling_Life/Course_Website` — the English course website
- `_archive/` in this project — the two documents this guide was merged from

## Keeping the download in step

`starter-book.zip` is a snapshot of this project. After you change the book,
open `make-starter-zip.R` and Source it to rebuild the zip; otherwise readers
download a stale copy.

## The logo

`figures/uu-logo.png` is the official Utrecht University logo. Use the files
from the [corporate identity site](https://www.uu.nl/en/organisation/corporate-identity)
rather than one pulled off a web page, and do not recolour, stretch or
reconstruct it.
